# Craftforge Pro Studio

> Craftforge Pro is a founder-led, premium boutique creative studio that forges premium brands, packaging, and digital products for ambitious Indian and global founders. We combine global craft standards with AI-native execution, cutting creative production times by 9x and reducing manual creative workloads by 67%.

## Core Details
- **URL**: https://craftforge.studio
- **Location**: Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- **Founder & Lead Creative Strategist**: Jahiruddin Sekh
- **Contact**: hello.craftforge.studio@gmail.com | +91 9641547271 (WhatsApp)
- **Hourly/Project Range**: Starter (₹1k – ₹25k) | Growth (₹25k – ₹75k) | Enterprise (₹75k+)
- **Core Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Runway ML, n8n, Make, Gemini API.
